text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- Supreme Court reduces sentences in "Necora case" and criticises judge Garzon
- The government wants to insure by decree that the strike will not alter basic services
- A builder gave a favourable chalet price to the Valencian councillor who gave the construction firm works
EL MUNDO
- Supreme Court absolves the "capo" Oubina of drug trafficking
- "Cut Aznar", Esperanza Aguirre was whistled at and insulted by the students of Madrid's Autonomous University who demanded more budget for education
- The future professional army will only have two soldiers for every command
- The public sector strike will principally hit schools and hospitals
DIARIO 16
- Vera says the great exchange of ETA terrorists for those of GAL is being negotiated
ABC
- The king laudits the Maghreb-Europe gas pipeline as a symbol of union before the 21st century
CINCO DIAS
- Record high business on the Spanish bourse; low rates and privatisations dissipate fear of a crash
- Fraga and Redondo "guides for all Spaniards"
- Counterattack of the soccer victims: hoteliers and leisure companies ask parliament to regulate TV emission
EXPANSION
- VW throws in the towel before GM
- France and Germany keep tension high on the decisive "summit" of Dublin
- The CECA designs the entrance of savings banks in Latin America
- Gas Natural will end the year with 50 billion in profits
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Iberdrola and Repsol accelerate their strategic alliance
- Aznar presents Fraga and Redondo the medal for merit in work
- The Constitutional Court reserves unemployment payment for the state
